newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak NBS sets 1-day repo tender for SKK 2.5bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak NBS sets 1-day repo tender for SKK 2.5bln.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Tuesday it had set a tender for a one-day securities repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering banks liquidity at a fixed volume of 2.5 billion crowns.
The NBS said in a statement that the American-style tender would have a minimum rate of 9.7 percent.
At the NBS's last overnight repurchase tender the average rate was 16.13 percent, up from 10.53 percent in the previous repo tender with a similar maturity.

According to official NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 97.69 percent as of Monday. The minimum reserve deadline is on Wednesday.
Results are released by 11 a.m. (1000 GMT) with allocations following later in the day.
